# Instructions for GitHub Copilot

The single source of truth for AI agents in this repository is `AGENTS.md` at the repository root. Read it first, then `docs/standards/README.md` and `docs/standards/PROJECT-PROFILE.md`, and follow them strictly.

Never write, edit or complete any Quran ayah, hadith, dhikr, du'a, tafsir or religious date from memory. Plan before coding, work only on the current branch, never push or merge, and finish every task with the review report from `docs/standards/08-review-and-dod.md`.
